educationalGoal: ・pronunciation: I read the sentence written in Korean clearly. You can write simple sentences in Korean. ・grammar: Write basic grammar. ・vocabulary: to freely use the most important 500 words. ・Verbal expression: Enable simple conversations using commonly used sentences.
advice: For students who have taken Korean Ⅰ and who can read and write. It is a subject that cultivates basic knowledge and operational ability of Korean based on class plan. Write basic sentences to convey your intentions. Comprehensively familiarize the 4 functions of reading, writing, listening, and speaking. This is the first step in broadening the international horizon by learning about culture, customs, history, and social affairs through audio-visual media so that the Korean world can be closer.
books: Textbooks: Beautiful Korean 1-2. Beautiful Korean School Reference books: Beautiful Korean 1-2. Workbook1-2 Reserved books: None
requiredKnowledge: ・Try to prepare and review classes and get used to new words. ・Study the four functions of reading, writing, listening, and speaking in a balanced manner. ・Try to memorize vocabulary ・Make sure to take notes.

activityGoals.body: Be able to basic daily conversation is possible.
Be able to use basic terms of daily life.
Be able to express opinions through speaking practice, round-table talks, and role plays.
Be able to read sentences for understanding Korean thought style, understand contents, and spread vocabulary.
Be able to use simple writing or practice to document your personality and use grammar and vocabulary
Be able to self- assessment of the behavioral goals that students must achieve in this subject.
